title: More NPCs
body:
If added, the player would be able to construct humanoid-shaped-but-not-human NPCs.
These NPCs wouldn't do anything except walk around and close/open doors, and would have no dialogue. They would be meant purely for decoration.

I don't have any examples right now as I don't want to make textures/models for these until I know if people want them or not.

**Update (August 21, 2026):** Overwhelmingly yes reacts, so this is being added.
